telemetry.interpretation: Command-to-visible is command receipt to first drawn generated boundary pose, not measured recognition of the requested action. Ready includes polling; it is not pure inference duration.
telemetry.cadence_assessment: Observed0 RAF gaps over100ms, max33.2ms. No generation-buffer hold recorded. RAF statistics describe main-loop cadence, not capture-frame delivery or a per-frame proof.
telemetry.duration_interpretation: 69.033s video contains49.0s of saved20fps motion plus wall-clock overhead and paused endpoint hold. It must not be described as69.033s of unique generated motion.
telemetry.timing_assessment: Command receipt to first drawn appended frame ranges2.982to3.116s (median3.0405s); no commands were queued. This measures first generated pose visibility, not semantic action onset. Meaningful behavior must use the separate semantic_response_latency section; first-output timing cannot be described as prompt-compliance timing.

metadata_caveat: This new recording has explicit current request seeds, requestIDs and framecounts; per-seam metadata is checked separately. It uses disclosed clearance-only fitted boot correction while preserving native source arrays.

tail_transfer.measurement: UTF-8 json.dumps allow_nan=False separators comma/colon, matching server serializer; local Review payloads, no HTTP or compression assumption.
tail_transfer.client_merge_review: mergeLiveTail verifies source/result identity, boundary, actor/fps/frame counts, then preserves oldFrames.slice(0,start) and concatenates the exact tail. Local Review tail arrays match full slices for all12 continuations; final cached fit equals direct full recompute bit-for-bit.

semantic_assessment.causal_caveat: The body was already nearly upright at frame739 before the new command first appears at740. Do not attribute all recovery to that command; hands lower further during its generated section.

continuity_assessment.interpretation: No displayed history is replaced. Native boundary velocity/acceleration is not guaranteed continuous. Raw motion is unedited; only disclosed foot-clearance retarget applies to the fitted mesh.

measurements.condition: Native Core pelvis-to-neck axis less than10degrees from vertical and BOTH wrist heights within plus/minus0.20m of hip height for10 consecutive source frames.

semantic_response_latency.method: Diagnostic threshold applied to preserved native Core source poses. First matching10-sample run is retrospectively identified; wall time is estimated from the nearest earlier directly logged first-drawn continuation boundary plus source frames/20.
limitations: Semantic threshold time is not directly timestamped by the browser; estimate assumes uninterrupted20fps source playback between the anchor and matching frame. Final capture records no buffer holds or RAF gaps over100ms, but no per-pose timestamp trace was saved.
Torso inclination tests magnitude, not forward direction or social meaning. Wrist-height thresholds do not prove hands are beside the torso, relaxed fingers, or planted feet.
These specified thresholds are useful descriptive proxies, not an aggregate prompt-compliance pass.
A ten-frame run spans0.45s between its first and last samples. The start is confirmed only after the final sample, so both onset and completed-window latencies are reported.
semantic_response_latency.conclusion: The approximately3second first-output latency is not semantic response latency. Report the measured behavior estimates separately.
